title: MZ RPG Maker NWJS overloading CPU?

posts.author: Seda
posts.body:
Hello all,
I have run into a strange issue while play testing my game.
Every time I go to play test my game it runs a batch of NWJS programs in the background (Found in my Task Manager). This is fine, as I am aware that this is important so my computer can run the application.
HOWEVER!
I have noticed that even after closing my Playtest, the NWJS continues to run in the background, and after opening and closing my playtests about 6-7 times my computer starts to lag and my CPU usage is up to 80%! I then have to go into task manager to End Task on all instances of NWJS to get my CPU usage back down to normal.
Is anyone else experiencing this issue, and if so, how do I go about fixing this??

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
I remember having that problem before frequently, but only after changing my nwjs version off of the base one for MV. Did you upgrade yours? I think it was on 49.1 that I saw it the most.
Check the system tray for an nwjs icon when it happens and check your options when you right click on it. i hadn't noticed the icon it till i started using 88.0, but I had the issue one time on 88.0, noticed it in the system tray, clicked something in the right click menu for it, and its been a couple months since its happened as opposed to like, 30% of the time i close a test

posts.author: Trihan
posts.body: Do you have the developer console open at the time? There used to be a bug where the process would remain if you close the game with the console open, and the solution was to close the console first. You may have ended up getting that for some reason.
